html:
The shit on a shingle recipe is one of those dishes that instantly takes people back in time. Whether you know it as shit on a shingle, SOS recipe, or creamed chipped beef, this humble plate of white gravy, salted beef, and toasted bread has fed generations. Originally rooted in military food, especially World War II food, this classic American recipe is now cherished as pure comfort food. Simple, hearty, affordable, and deeply nostalgic, this easy breakfast and savory gravy dish remains an old-fashioned recipe loved by home cooks across the U.S.

What Is Shit on a Shingle?

Shit on a shingle is a vintage recipe made from creamed chipped beef served over toasted white bread. At its core, it’s a milk-based gravy thickened with a flour and butter roux, mixed with sliced dried beef, and spooned generously onto a crispy toast base.

This dish is also known as:

  • Creamed beef on toast

  • SOS recipe

  • Classic shit on a shingle

  • Traditional SOS recipe

  • Military SOS recipe

Despite the crude name, it’s a deeply nostalgic American food and a surprisingly protein-rich breakfast.

Why Is It Called SOS? (Military Origins Explained)

The nickname SOS comes straight from the U.S. military, particularly the Army recipe culture during World War II.

WW2 Shit on a Shingle History

  • Soldiers were often served dried beef in jars

  • The beef was extremely salty and shelf-stable

  • It was cooked into chipped beef gravy

  • Served on toasted bread in mess halls

The humorously crude term “shit on a shingle” was soldiers’ way of coping with repetitive budget meal rations. Over time, army SOS recipe became a staple stovetop comfort meal even after the war.

Shit on a Shingle Recipe (Classic Version)

This section focuses on the classic shit on a shingle recipe exactly as it was made in homes and army kitchens.

Ingredients (Five-Ingredient Recipe Base)

  • Dried beef (or chipped beef slices)

  • Unsalted butter

  • All-purpose flour

  • Whole milk

  • Black pepper

Optional seasonings:

  • Garlic powder

  • Onion powder

  • Paprika

  • Worcestershire sauce (optional)

  • Salt (optional – dried beef is salty)

This simple list is why SOS is known as a five-ingredient recipe and a true cheap comfort food recipe.

How to Make Shit on a Shingle (Step-by-Step Instructions)

How to Cook Chipped Beef

  1. Remove sliced dried beef from the jar

  2. Rinse briefly under warm water to reduce salty dried beef flavor

  3. Pat dry and slice into bite-size pieces

This step is essential for controlling saltiness in homemade shit on a shingle.

Stovetop Gravy Instructions

 

Step 1: Make the Roux

  • Melt unsalted butter in a skillet

  • Whisk in all-purpose flour

  • Cook until lightly golden

This is your flour and butter roux, the foundation of homemade gravy.

Step 2: Create the White Gravy

  • Slowly add whole milk

  • Whisk constantly

  • Let it simmer until thickened gravy forms

You’re now making a smooth white sauce or white gravy.

Step 3: Add the Beef

  • Stir in pan-fried beef or rinsed chipped beef

  • Season with black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika

This becomes a rich creamy beef gravy.

How to Thicken White Gravy Properly

 

If your shit on a shingle gravy is too thin.

  • Simmer longer on low heat

  • Add a small slurry of flour + milk

  • Avoid overheating (milk can break)

Mastering this makes SOS a perfect beginner gravy recipe and quick gravy from scratch skill.

How to Serve Creamed Beef

Shit on a Shingle on Toast

  1. Toast toasted white bread until golden

  2. Use a crispy toast base

  3. Spoon hot creamed beef on toast generously

This is the classic shit on a shingle on toast presentation.

Shit on a Shingle Breakfast vs Dinner

 

Hearty Breakfast

  • Traditional shit on a shingle breakfast

  • High in protein

  • Keeps you full for hours

Quick Weeknight Meal

  • Ready in under 20 minutes

  • Perfect stovetop recipe

  • Ideal quick SOS recipe

Shit on a Shingle Army Style

The shit on a shingle army style version uses:

  • Extra thick sos gravy recipe

  • Minimal seasoning

  • No garnish

It’s raw, filling, and built for fuel not flair.

Old Fashioned Shit on a Shingle Variations

 

Shit on a Shingle with Chipped Beef

The original and most nostalgic version.

Shit on a Shingle with Ground Beef

  • Uses browned ground beef

  • Less salty

  • Popular modern SOS recipe

Shit on a Shingle with Sausage

  • Breakfast sausage

  • Adds spice and richness

Homemade SOS Without Chipped Beef

 

If you can’t find dried beef in jars, try.

  • Ground beef

  • Turkey

  • Sausage

This creates a flexible homemade SOS without chipped beef.

Healthier SOS Recipe Options

Low-Fat Creamed Beef

  • Use low-fat milk

  • Less butter

Gluten-Free Shit on a Shingle

  • Gluten-free flour

  • Gluten-free toast

These versions modernize this classic American recipe.

Why Shit on a Shingle Is Comfort Food

  • Warm

  • Creamy

  • Salty

  • Nostalgic

This savory breakfast dish represents survival, simplicity, and history true comfort food.

Nutritional Information (Approximate)

Per serving:

  • Calories: 420

  • Protein: High (protein-rich breakfast)

  • Fat: Moderate

  • Sodium: High (rinse beef to reduce)

Cheap Comfort Food Recipes Like SOS

SOS belongs to a family of budget meal classics. For another iconic comfort dish, check out this related recipe Popeyes Recipe for Red Beans

Frequently Asked Questions About Shit on a Shingle

What is shit on a shingle?

Shit on a shingle is a classic American dish made with creamed chipped beef served over toasted bread, commonly known as SOS.

Why is it called SOS?

SOS is a military nickname from World War II, standing for “shit on a shingle,” referring humorously to creamed beef on toast.

What kind of beef is used in SOS?

Traditional SOS uses dried chipped beef, usually sold in glass jars, which is thinly sliced and salted.

Is shit on a shingle a breakfast or dinner dish?

It’s commonly served as a hearty breakfast but can also be eaten for lunch or dinner.

How do you reduce saltiness in chipped beef?

Rinse the dried beef under warm water or soak it briefly in milk before cooking.

Can I make SOS without chipped beef?

Yes, ground beef, sausage, or turkey can be used as substitutes.

Is shit on a shingle the same as creamed beef?

Yes, creamed beef on toast is the formal name for shit on a shingle.
